description:
Butterflies are beautiful. That goes without saying. But they're also absolute maniacs when it comes getting their next meal. Watch as we debunk the myth that they only drink pollen and show the dark side of butterfly cuisine.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
